summary: Diagnosed the previous lease-bound attempt: that receipt's exit code was 1 because a configuration change in another case of the same file raced an election ('remove 4: node is not the leader'), which left both the bound unmeasured and the receipt uncitable. I added a retry helper so configuration changes re-poll the current leader and reject only non-leadership errors, confirmed that every assurance case in the harness passes locally, and requeued the same measurement as a successor on the fixed harness. The recorded account is unchanged: its exposure bound is still stated from source, and this turn adds no execution-based claim.
